_說明: IA2（Connections Book 2）文法。cards＝文法小卡；questions＝文法題（choice 選擇、order 排句子）；listening＝聽力題（lfill、lpick、lorder）。a＝正確選項位置（從 0 開始），App 會打亂選項順序。

U1.title: Compound Relative Pronouns
U1.zh: 複合關係代名詞：whoever／whatever／whenever／wherever／whichever／however＝「不管是誰／什麼／何時／哪裡／哪一個／怎麼……」
rules: whoever＝不管是誰；任何……的人
Whoever reaches the top of Everest must be very strong.
whatever＝不管什麼；任何……的東西
The Sherpa carry whatever the climbers need.
whenever＝不管什麼時候；每次
Whenever it snows, the trail is closed.
wherever＝不管去哪裡
Wherever the climbers go, they leave trash behind.
whichever＝不管哪一個（有幾個可以選）
You can take whichever trail you like.
however＝不管用什麼方法
However you climb Everest, it is still dangerous.
phrases: Which tent do you want? — Whichever.　Where should we eat? — Wherever.
It doesn't matter who … ／ Any person who … → Whoever …
mistakes: Who wins the race will get a prize.
Whoever wins the race will get a prize.
「任何……的人」要用 whoever
Whatever you go, I will go with you.
Wherever you go, I will go with you.
地方用 wherever
However you want, you can eat it.
Whatever you want, you can eat it.
東西用 whatever；however 是「方法」
Whoever you climb, it is dangerous.
However you climb, it is dangerous.
「不管怎麼爬」是方法 → however

U2.title: Subordinate Conjunctions
U2.zh: 從屬連接詞：even though／although（雖然）、as long as（只要）、as soon as（一……就）。可以放在句子開頭（要加逗號）或中間
rules: even though／although＝雖然……（前後意思相反）
Even though Crow was hungry, he helped Little Bear.
⚠️ 中文說「雖然……但是……」，英文只能用一個：although 就不能再加 but
Although the story is old, it still teaches us a lesson.
as long as＝只要……（條件）
As long as we work together, we will survive.
as soon as＝一……就……（馬上接著發生）
As soon as Pangu woke up, he broke the egg.
放在句子中間：不用逗號
Little Bear kept walking although it was dark.
phrases: even though ≈ although　as long as ≈ while（在……的期間）　as soon as ≈ when（就在那時）
mistakes: Although the story is old, but it still has meaning.
Although the story is old, it still has meaning.
although 和 but 只能留一個
As soon as we work together, we will survive.
As long as we work together, we will survive.
「只要」是 as long as
Even though I get home, I will call you.
As soon as I get home, I will call you.
「一到家就」是 as soon as

U3.title: Indefinite Pronouns
U3.zh: 不定代名詞：不說清楚是「誰、什麼、哪裡」。人用 -body／-one、東西用 -thing、地方用 -where
rules: some-：肯定句、yes 的回答
Someone donated $1,000 to our project!
any-：問句
Did anyone watch our video?
no-：「沒有」，當主詞時動詞不加 not
No one gave up.
any- 當受詞時：動詞加 not
I didn't see anything on the website.
every-：每一個（動詞用單數）
Everyone likes the Griz Coat.
人：somebody／someone…　東西：something…　地方：somewhere…
I put my phone somewhere, but I can't find it.
phrases: Will anyone donate? → Yes, someone will. ／ No, no one will.
No, I didn't buy anything.＝No, I bought nothing.
mistakes: No one didn't donate.
No one donated.
no one 已經是「沒有」，動詞不再加 not
I didn't see nothing.
I didn't see anything.
有 not 的時候用 any-
Everyone like crowdfunding.
Everyone likes crowdfunding.
everyone 當一個人看，動詞加 s
Did you buy something? No, I didn't buy something.
Did you buy anything? No, I didn't buy anything.
問句和否定用 any-

U4.title: Passive Voice: Reporting Verbs
U4.zh: 用被動語態說「大家都說／大家相信」：It ＋ is／was／has been ＋ said／believed／thought ＋ that…（說的人不重要，或不確定是不是真的）
rules: It is said that…＝據說……
It is said that wushu was developed 4,000 years ago.
It is believed that…＝一般相信……
It is believed that tai chi keeps people healthy.
It was thought that…＝以前大家認為……（現在不一定這樣想）
It was thought that the earth was flat.
It has been said that…＝一直有人說……
It has been said that Bruce Lee was very fast.
改寫：Many people say/believe that … → It is said/believed that …
Many people believe that … → It is believed that …
確定是事實就直接說，不用這個句型
Bruce Lee was a famous actor.
phrases: Many people think → It is thought／Many people thought → It was thought／Many people have said → It has been said
mistakes: It is say that wushu is old.
It is said that wushu is old.
is 後面要用過去分詞 said
It believed that tai chi is healthy.
It is believed that tai chi is healthy.
被動要有 is／was
Many people believed that … → It is believed that …
It was believed that …
原句是過去式 → was

U5.title: may／might／could ＋ have ＋ p.p.
U5.zh: 猜測「過去可能發生過」的事：may／might／could (not) ＋ have ＋ 過去分詞；could not have＝「不可能」
rules: may have ＋ p.p.＝可能已經……（不確定）
The first city may have been in Turkey.
might have ＋ p.p.＝也許……（不確定）
The ancient people might have used the river for water.
could have ＋ p.p.＝有可能……
Mallory could have reached the top in 1924.
may not／might not have ＋ p.p.＝可能沒有……
The archaeologists may not have found everything.
⚠️ could not have ＋ p.p.＝「不可能」……（我不相信）
The statues couldn't have moved by themselves.
phrases: Maybe ＋ 過去式 → might have ＋ p.p.／It's possible that … → could have ＋ p.p.／It's not possible that … → couldn't have ＋ p.p.
mistakes: The climbers may has died in the storm.
The climbers may have died in the storm.
may 後面一律用 have
They might have went home.
They might have gone home.
have 後面用過去分詞 gone
He couldn't have forget the answer.
He couldn't have forgotten the answer.
forget → forgotten

U6.title: by ＋ V-ing／with ＋ (n.)
U6.zh: 說「怎麼做到的」：by ＋ 動名詞（用什麼方法）、with ＋ 名詞（用什麼東西）
rules: by ＋ V-ing＝藉由（做什麼事）
The police find the truth by collecting evidence.
by 可以放句首，要加逗號
By staying calm, you might trick a polygraph.
with ＋ 名詞＝用（什麼東西）
Scientists can see the brain with fMRI.
改寫：use ＋ 東西 ＋ to V → V ＋ with ＋ 東西
I used tape to fix the light. → I fixed the light with tape.
改寫：because ＋ 句子 → by ＋ V-ing
Alex learns English well because he reads every day. → Alex learns English well by reading every day.
phrases: by 後面接「做的事」（動作 V-ing）；with 後面接「東西」（名詞）
mistakes: You can feel better by sleep eight hours.
You can feel better by sleeping eight hours.
by 後面用 V-ing
He cleaned his ear by his finger.
He cleaned his ear with his finger.
用「東西」→ with
We finished the job with working hard.
We finished the job by working hard.
做的事（動作）→ by V-ing

U1.q: ___ reaches the top of Everest must be very strong.
The Sherpa carry ___ the climbers need.
___ the climbers go, they leave trash behind.
___ you climb Everest, it is still dangerous.
___ I visit Grandma, she gives me a big hug.
Which trail do you want to take? — ___. They are both fine.
U1.tip: 從幾個選項裡選、哪個都可以 → whichever

U1.q: I don't care where we go. ___ we go, I will have fun.
Any person who watches this movie will cry. → ___ watches this movie will cry.
It doesn't matter what you cook. ___ you cook, I will eat it.
Any time you call me, I will answer. → ___ you call me, I will answer.
___ finds my dog will get a reward.

U2.q: ___ Crow couldn't catch fish, he could fly very high.
U2.tip: 前後意思相反（不會抓魚／很會飛）→ even though

U2.q: ___ we work together, we will survive.
U2.tip: 「只要」一起合作 → as long as

U2.q: ___ Pangu woke up, he broke the egg.
Although the story is very old, ___ still teaches us a lesson.
U2.tip: although 已經有「雖然」，後面不能再加 but

U2.q: We can keep playing ___ it is bright enough to see.
U2.tip: 「只要」天還夠亮 → as long as

U2.q: Tim was still tired ___ he slept for ten hours.
U2.tip: 睡很久卻還是累 → 意思相反 → although

U2.q: I will call you ___ I get home.
___ the student tried his best, studying was still difficult.
U2.tip: 很努力卻還是難 → even though

U2.q: You can play outside ___ you finish your homework first.
U2.tip: 條件：只要先寫完功課 → as long as

U2.q: ___ the bell rings, we can go home.
U2.tip: 鐘一響就 → as soon as
Even though ＋ 句子, ＋ 句子
As soon as ＋ 句子, ＋ 句子
放在句子中間不用逗號

U3.q: ___ in my class watched the Pebble video, so we all know about it.
The campaign got ___, so the brothers were very sad.
U3.tip: 很難過 → 什麼都沒募到 → nothing

U3.q: No, I didn't tell ___ about our project.
U3.tip: 有 didn't 了，受詞用 any-

U3.q: I saved the video ___, but I can't find it now.
___ needs to give a lot of money. Many people give a little.
U3.tip: 「沒有人」需要給很多 → no one

U3.q: Crowdfunding is open to ___. You can be rich or poor.
Is there ___ to eat? I'm hungry.
We looked ___ for the cat, but we couldn't find it.

U4.q: Many people say that wushu was developed by farmers. → It is ___ that wushu was developed by farmers.
Many people believe that tai chi is good for your health. → It ___ believed that tai chi is good for your health.
Many people thought that being cold gave people the flu. → It ___ thought that being cold gave people the flu.
Many people have said that Everest is the most dangerous mountain. → It has ___ said that Everest is the most dangerous mountain.
It is said ___ wushu was developed by an emperor.
U4.tip: It is said ＋ that ＋ 句子

U4.q: Many people believe that aliens will come soon. → It is ___ that aliens will come soon.
I'm not sure it's true, but ___ that the monks could break stones with their hands.
U4.tip: 不確定、只是聽說 → it is said that

U4.q: Many people thought tomorrow's typhoon would be bad. → It ___ thought that the typhoon would be bad.
It ___ believed that Sun Tzu wrote The Art of War.
Many people say that kung fu masters can fly. → ___ said that kung fu masters can fly.

U4.tip: It ＋ is ＋ said ＋ that ＋ 句子
過去的看法用 was thought

U5.q: Maybe the climbers went back down. → The climbers might have ___ back down.
It's possible that the Greeks used this tunnel. → The Greeks ___ have used this tunnel.
It's not possible that a child carved this huge statue. → A child ___ have carved this huge statue.
Maybe the old city was not built by one group. → The old city may not have ___ built by one group.
The first city may ___ been in Turkey.
Mallory could have ___ the top, but nobody knows.
The statues are too heavy. One man ___ have carried them.
U5.tip: 太重了，不可能 → couldn't have

U5.q: Ancient people might have ___ near rivers because animals came to drink.
I don't believe it! My best friend ___ have forgotten my birthday.
U5.tip: 不相信、不可能 → couldn't have

U5.q: Jane may have ___ my watch. I'm not sure.

U6.q: The interviewer measures your pulse ___ sensors.
You might trick a polygraph by ___ calm.
Mia got better at English because she reads every day. → Mia got better at English by ___ every day.
The nurse uses a machine to check my blood pressure. → The nurse checks my blood pressure ___ a machine.
If you think of something stressful, you can trick the test. → ___ thinking of something stressful, you can trick the test.
The police used gloves to pick up the evidence. → The police picked up the evidence ___ gloves.
By ___ the past, we can learn about the future.
We might make a better lie detector ___ fMRI.
The police solve crimes by ___ evidence.
You could get to school faster ___ taking a taxi.

U6.tip: By ＋ V-ing 放句首加逗號

U1.say: Whoever climbs Everest needs extra oxygen.
Whenever it snows, the trail is closed.
opts: Whenever it snows, the trail is closed.
Wherever it snows, the trail is closed.
However it snows, the trail is closed.
U1.tip: 聽清楚 whenever（每次、什麼時候）

U1.say: Bring whatever you need for the trip.
U1.q: Bring ___ you need for the trip.

U2.say: As soon as Crow saw Little Bear, he flew down.
U2.q: ___ Crow saw Little Bear, he flew down.
U2.tip: 一看到就飛下來 → as soon as

U2.say: Although it was dark, Little Bear kept walking.
opts: Although it was dark, Little Bear kept walking.
As long as it was dark, Little Bear kept walking.
As soon as it was dark, Little Bear kept walking.

U2.say: Even though the story is old, it still has meaning.
U2.q: ___ the story is old, it still has meaning.
U2.tip: 舊卻還有意義 → even though
As long as ＋ 句子, ＋ 句子

U3.tip: 聽清楚 no one（沒有人）

U3.say: Everybody in my class watched the video.
U3.q: ___ in my class watched the video.

U4.say: It is said that the monks practiced every day.
U4.q: It is ___ that the monks practiced every day.

U4.say: It was thought that the sun moved around the earth.
opts: It was thought that the sun moved around the earth.
It is thought that the sun moved around the earth.
It has been thought that the sun moved around the earth.
U4.tip: 聽清楚 was（過去的看法）

U4.say: It is believed that wushu is good for the mind.
U4.q: It is ___ that wushu is good for the mind.

U5.say: The first climbers might not have been the winners.
U5.q: The first climbers might not have ___ the winners.

U5.say: The monk couldn't have lied to us.
opts: The monk couldn't have lied to us.
The monk could have lied to us.
The monk might have lied to us.

U5.say: The ancient people may have used the river for water.
U5.q: The ancient people may have ___ the river for water.

U6.say: The police found the thief by working hard.
U6.q: The police found the thief by ___ hard.

U6.say: I will fix the needle with tape.
opts: I will fix the needle with tape.
I will fix the needle by tape.
I will fix the needle for tape.

U6.say: Scientists study the brain with fMRI.

strategy.name: Timeline + Problem & Solution
strategy.intro: 課文很長、數字很多？先抓時間線，再分清楚「出了什麼問題」和「怎麼解決」。

parts.q: 找年份：先發生什麼？後來呢？
哪裡出了問題？為什麼危險？
有人怎麼處理？還可以怎麼做？

strategy.tip: 先把年份和數字圈起來，再一段一段問自己：「這段在說什麼？」看到 To help、so、However 這種字要停下來。

teach.title: Everest: Too Many Climbers?
paras: Mount Everest is the tallest mountain in the world.
It is on the border between Nepal and China's Tibet region.
The first efforts to climb it began in the 1920s.
In 1924, two climbers got very close to the top, but they never came back.
In 1953, Tenzing Norgay and Edmund Hillary finally reached the top together.
In 1993, businesses started selling climbing services.
Professional climbers plan the trip and do the hard work, so amateur climbers can go too.
Now hundreds of climbers wait in long lines on steep, narrow trails.
Many of them also leave trash on the mountain.
To help, Nepal makes each climber carry 8 kg of trash down.
Everest is still very dangerous.
Climbers fall, freeze, or get sick from the low oxygen, and avalanches can kill many people at once.
The Sherpa are people from Nepal, and their bodies work well high up on the mountain.
They carry heavy packs and do almost all the dangerous work.
Most of the people who died in the 2014 avalanche were Sherpa.
However Nepal solves these problems, it should do it soon.
zh: 聖母峰是世界上最高的山。
它在尼泊爾和中國西藏地區的邊界上。
第一批攀登它的嘗試從 1920 年代開始。
1924 年，兩個登山家已經非常接近山頂，但是再也沒有回來。
1953 年，丹增・諾蓋和艾德蒙・希拉瑞終於一起登上山頂。
1993 年，公司開始販賣登山服務。
專業登山家規劃行程、做困難的工作，所以業餘登山客也能去。
現在好幾百個登山客在又陡又窄的山路上排長長的隊。
他們很多人也把垃圾留在山上。
為了改善，尼泊爾規定每個登山客要帶 8 公斤的垃圾下山。
聖母峰還是非常危險。
登山客會摔落、凍傷，或因為氧氣太少而生病，雪崩也可能一次奪走很多人的性命。
雪巴人是尼泊爾的原住民，他們的身體在高山上也能好好運作。
他們背很重的背包，幾乎做了所有危險的工作。
2014 年雪崩的罹難者大部分是雪巴人。
不管尼泊爾用什麼方法解決這些問題，都應該快一點。

steps.q: 第一段大部分在講什麼？
opts: The first people who tried to climb Everest
How much an Everest trip costs
ozh: 最早嘗試爬聖母峰的人
聖母峰為什麼這麼危險
steps.hint: 這段有好幾個年份：1920s、1924、1953。這些年份都在講什麼人做什麼事？
steps.why: 1920s 開始嘗試、1924 年兩個人沒回來、1953 年第一次登頂——整段都在講「最早去爬聖母峰的人」。

steps.q: Who were the first people to reach the top?
ozh: 丹增・諾蓋和艾德蒙・希拉瑞
steps.hint: 找 finally 和 reached the top。1924 年那兩個人 never came back，他們有沒有確定登頂？
steps.why: In 1953, Tenzing Norgay and Edmund Hillary finally reached the top together. finally＝「終於」，表示前面的人都沒成功。

steps.q: Why can amateur climbers climb Everest now?
opts: Professional climbers plan the trip and do the hard work.
The trails are wider and safer now.
There is more oxygen on the mountain now.
ozh: 專業登山家規劃行程、做困難的工作。
現在山路比較寬、比較安全。
現在山上的氧氣比較多。
steps.hint: 找 so：so 後面是結果（業餘的人也能去），so 前面就是原因。
steps.why: Professional climbers plan the trip and do the hard work, so amateur climbers can go too. 原因在 so 前面。文章說山路又陡又窄，沒有變寬喔。

steps.q: What does "8 kg" mean in this paragraph?
opts: The trash each climber must carry down
The weight of one oxygen tank
The food a climber eats in one day
ozh: 每個登山客要帶下山的垃圾
steps.hint: 數字偵探：8 kg 前後是什麼字？To help 後面是在解決哪個問題？
steps.why: To help, Nepal makes each climber carry 8 kg of trash down. 這是解決「垃圾問題」的方法。

steps.q: Who does almost all the dangerous work?
steps.hint: 找 almost all the dangerous work，往前看 They 指的是誰。
steps.why: They carry heavy packs and do almost all the dangerous work. They＝前一句的 the Sherpa。代名詞要往前找它指誰！

steps.q: What does the last sentence mean?
opts: Nepal should fix the problems soon, in any way it can.
Nepal has already fixed the problems.
Nepal does not want to fix the problems.
ozh: 不管用什麼方法，尼泊爾都應該快點解決問題。
尼泊爾已經解決問題了。
steps.hint: However ＋ 句子＝「不管怎麼……」——這就是本單元的句型！
steps.why: However Nepal solves these problems＝不管尼泊爾怎麼解決；it should do it soon＝都應該快一點。這句用的是本單元的複合關係代名詞 however。

sum: 兩個人差一點登頂，但沒有回來
Norgay 和 Hillary 第一次登頂
公司開始賣登山服務，業餘的人也能爬
人太多、垃圾多、雪崩危險；雪巴人做最危險的工作

practice.title: Three Problems on Everest
sents: Everest has three big problems today.
The first problem is crowds: sometimes hundreds of people wait in line on one narrow trail.
The second problem is trash.
Climbers leave tents, bottles, and human waste, and the cold keeps the waste from disappearing.
Nepal already makes each climber carry 8 kg of trash down, and this has helped some.
The third problem is danger, especially for the Sherpa.
In 2015, an earthquake caused an avalanche, and 22 more people were killed.
Some people think Nepal should allow only a few climbers each year.
Others think only small teams should climb together.
Whatever Nepal decides, the mountain needs help soon.
zh: 聖母峰現在有三個大問題。
第一個問題是人潮：有時候好幾百個人在同一條窄山路上排隊。
第二個問題是垃圾。
登山客留下帳篷、瓶子和排泄物，而且天氣太冷，排泄物不會分解消失。
尼泊爾已經規定每個登山客要帶 8 公斤垃圾下山，這有一點幫助。
第三個問題是危險，特別是對雪巴人。
2015 年，一場地震引發雪崩，又有 22 個人罹難。
有些人認為尼泊爾每年應該只讓少數登山客上山。
也有人認為只能讓小隊伍一起爬。
不管尼泊爾決定怎麼做，這座山都需要趕快被幫助。

tasks.q: 每張卡片是「問題」還是「解決方法」？（6 張都要分對）
items: long lines on one narrow trail
同一條窄山路上大排長龍
human waste that doesn't disappear
不會消失的排泄物
an avalanche caused by an earthquake
地震引發的雪崩
carry 8 kg of trash down
帶 8 公斤垃圾下山
allow only a few climbers each year
每年只讓少數人上山
only small teams climb together
只讓小隊伍一起爬
tasks.hint: 問自己：這件事是讓山「變糟」（問題），還是讓山「變好」（解決）？看到 should、makes … carry 通常是解決方法。
tasks.why: 人潮、排泄物、雪崩是問題；帶垃圾下山已經在做，限制人數、只讓小隊伍爬是有人提出的解決方法。

tasks.q: 🔢 數字偵探：What does "22" mean in this passage?
opts: The people killed in the 2015 avalanche
The climbers waiting on one trail
The kilograms of trash each climber carries
ozh: 在一條山路上排隊的人數
每個人要帶的垃圾公斤數
tasks.hint: 找到 22，看它後面接的是什麼字（people? kg?）。
tasks.why: In 2015, an earthquake caused an avalanche, and 22 more people were killed. 22 後面是 people were killed。垃圾是 8 kg 喔。

tasks.q: 🔍 句型尋寶：哪一句用了本單元的句型（whoever／whatever／wherever／however…）？點出那一句。
tasks.hint: 找開頭是 Wh…ever 或 However 的句子。
tasks.why: Whatever Nepal decides, the mountain needs help soon.＝不管尼泊爾決定什麼，這座山都需要幫助。whatever＝不管什麼。

strategy.name: Story → Lesson
strategy.intro: 課文裡有好幾個小故事：先看懂「發生什麼事」，再找「它想教我們什麼」。

parts.q: 誰？發生了什麼事？最後怎麼了？
這個故事想教我們什麼？

strategy.tip: 找 The story teaches us that…、The lesson is… 這種句子，後面通常就是道理。一個故事講完，下一段常常換新的故事。

teach.title: Why Do We Tell Stories?
paras: Long ago, people didn't have the Internet, TV, or even books.
To entertain themselves, they told stories.
But stories were not only for fun.
They also taught lessons.
The Chinese story of Pangu tells how the world began.
Pangu slept inside a black egg for 18,000 years.
When he woke up, he stretched and broke the egg into heaven and earth.
He held heaven up with his hands and held the earth down with his feet, so the two stayed separate.
The story teaches us that the world needs balance, like light (yang) and darkness (yin).
A story from Canada's west coast is about Crow and Little Bear.
Little Bear wandered away and got lost, and Crow was not good at catching food.
Crow flew high and showed Little Bear the way home, and Little Bear caught fish for Crow.
Neither of them could survive alone, but together they made it home.
The lesson is that we should share and work together.
In an old Buddhist story, a student had difficulty remembering what he read.
His teacher said, "Keep studying. You'll feel differently soon."
Later, studying became easy, and the teacher said the same thing again.
Everything in life changes, so we shouldn't get too happy or too sad.
Even though these stories are old, they still have meaning for us today.
zh: 很久以前，人們沒有網路、電視，甚至沒有書。
為了娛樂自己，他們說故事。
但是故事不只是為了好玩。
故事也在教道理。
中國盤古的故事說的是世界怎麼開始。
盤古在一顆黑色的蛋裡睡了一萬八千年。
他醒來後伸了個懶腰，把蛋打破，變成天和地。
他用手撐住天、用腳踩住地，所以天和地一直分開。
這個故事教我們：世界需要平衡，就像光明（陽）和黑暗（陰）。
一個來自加拿大西岸的故事，主角是烏鴉和小熊。
小熊走丟迷路了，而烏鴉不太會抓食物。
烏鴉飛得高高的，幫小熊指出回家的路；小熊抓魚給烏鴉吃。
他們誰都沒辦法自己活下去，但是一起合作就回到了家。
道理是：我們應該分享、一起合作。
在一個古老的佛教故事裡，一個學生很難記住他讀過的東西。
老師說：「繼續讀，你很快就會有不同的感覺。」
後來讀書變簡單了，老師又說了一樣的話。
人生的每件事都會改變，所以我們不應該太開心或太難過。
雖然這些故事很古老，對現在的我們還是有意義。

steps.q: Why did ancient people tell stories?
opts: To have fun and to teach lessons
To learn how to use the Internet
ozh: 為了好玩，也為了教道理
steps.hint: 有兩個原因：一個在 To entertain themselves，另一個在 They also…
steps.why: To entertain themselves, they told stories.（為了好玩）＋ They also taught lessons.（也教道理）。also 表示「還有另一個」。

steps.q: What did Pangu do after he woke up?
opts: He broke the egg into heaven and earth.
He gave the egg to the gods.
ozh: 他把蛋打破，變成天和地。
steps.hint: 找 When he woke up，後面就是答案。
steps.why: When he woke up, he stretched and broke the egg into heaven and earth. 18,000 年是他「醒來之前」睡的時間。

steps.q: What does the Pangu story teach us?
steps.hint: 找 The story teaches us that…
steps.why: The story teaches us that the world needs balance——光明和黑暗都要有，不是哪一個比較好。

steps.q: How did Crow help Little Bear?
opts: He flew high and showed him the way home.
He carried him home on his back.
ozh: 他飛得高高的，幫小熊指出回家的路。
steps.hint: 小心！這句有兩個人在幫忙。and 前面是誰幫誰？and 後面是誰幫誰？
steps.why: Crow flew high and showed Little Bear the way home.（烏鴉幫小熊）, and Little Bear caught fish for Crow.（小熊幫烏鴉）。抓魚的是小熊喔。

steps.q: What is the lesson of Crow and Little Bear?
opts: We should share and work together.
Bears are better at fishing than birds.
ozh: 我們應該分享、一起合作。
steps.hint: 找 The lesson is that…
steps.why: The lesson is that we should share and work together. 小熊會抓魚、烏鴉會飛，各有所長，合作才活得下去。

steps.q: Why did the teacher say the same thing two times?
opts: Because everything changes, on good days and bad days.
Because he forgot what he said before.
ozh: 因為不管好日子或壞日子，一切都會改變。
因為他忘記自己說過了。
steps.hint: 第一次是學生覺得很難（壞日子），第二次是覺得很簡單（好日子）。找講「道理」的那一句。
steps.why: Everything in life changes, so we shouldn't get too happy or too sad. 難的時候會變簡單，簡單的時候也可能再變難，所以老師兩次都說「你很快會有不同的感覺」。

sum: 一切都會改變，別太開心也別太難過

practice.title: The Two Farmers
sents: Two farmers lived next to each other.
One farmer had an orchard full of apple trees, and the other had a river full of fish.
For years, they never talked to each other.
One summer, it didn't rain, and the apple trees started to die.
The river got low, too, and the fish were hard to catch.
As soon as the apple farmer saw his neighbor's empty net, he brought him a barrel of apples.
The fish farmer was surprised, and he gave the apple farmer water from the river for his trees.
Even though it was a hard summer, both farmers made it through.
After that, they always shared what they had.
zh: 兩個農夫住在隔壁。
一個農夫有一座種滿蘋果樹的果園，另一個有一條滿是魚的河。
很多年來，他們從來不跟對方說話。
有一年夏天都沒下雨，蘋果樹開始枯死。
河水也變少了，魚很難抓。
蘋果農夫一看到鄰居空空的魚網，就帶了一桶蘋果給他。
養魚的農夫很驚訝，他把河水分給蘋果農夫澆樹。
雖然那是一個很辛苦的夏天，兩個農夫都撐過去了。
從那之後，他們總是分享自己擁有的東西。

tasks.q: 把三件事照故事順序排好
items: It doesn't rain, and both farmers have problems.
沒下雨，兩個農夫都遇到麻煩。
The apple farmer brings a barrel of apples.
蘋果農夫帶來一桶蘋果。
The farmers always share after that.
兩個農夫從此都會分享。
tasks.hint: 用導讀卡的「故事」問句：先發生什麼麻煩？誰先幫忙？最後怎麼了？
tasks.why: 先是沒下雨（蘋果樹枯、魚難抓）；接著蘋果農夫看到空魚網就送蘋果；最後兩人從此互相分享。

tasks.q: 💡 What lesson does this story teach?
opts: Neighbors should help and share with each other.
Farmers should not live near rivers.
ozh: 鄰居應該互相幫忙、分享。
tasks.hint: 跟課文哪一個故事的道理很像？（烏鴉和小熊？）
tasks.why: 兩個農夫各有東西（蘋果／河水），互相幫忙才撐過夏天——跟烏鴉和小熊一樣：分享、一起合作。

tasks.q: 🔍 哪一句告訴你「雖然很辛苦，兩個人都撐過去了」？點出那一句。
tasks.hint: 找本單元的連接詞 Even though（雖然）。
tasks.why: Even though it was a hard summer, both farmers made it through. even though＝雖然；made it through＝撐過去。

strategy.name: Steps + Number Detective
strategy.intro: 講「怎麼做」的文章：先抓步驟順序，再把每個數字對上它的意思。

parts.q: 先做什麼？接著呢？最後呢？
這個數字是多少錢？多少人？多久？

strategy.tip: First、Then、If 是步驟的路標；看到 $ 和 million、billion，停下來問「這是誰的錢？」

teach.title: Paying for a Dream
paras: Entrepreneurs with big ideas need money to start a business.
In the past, they borrowed money from relatives, took loans from banks, or asked rich investors.
Now there is an easier way: crowdfunding.
First, the entrepreneur starts a project profile on a crowdfunding website.
The profile has a business plan and a video.
Then the entrepreneur tells people about it on social media.
People invest because they believe in the cause, or because they want rewards like gifts or new products.
Many people give a small amount, so no one needs to give a lot.
If the campaign doesn't reach its goal, no one pays anything.
A company called Pebble used crowdfunding to develop a smartwatch.
It raised over $1 million in less than a day and over $10 million in the end.
Two brothers wanted $3,000 to make coats that look like bears, but they got $30,000!
Around the world, people donated $6 billion in 2013 and $16 billion in 2014.
With crowdfunding, anyone can bring a big or crazy idea to the world.
zh: 有大點子的創業家需要錢來創業。
以前，他們跟親戚借錢、向銀行貸款，或請有錢的投資人出錢。
現在有一個比較簡單的方法：群眾募資。
首先，創業家在群眾募資網站上建立一個專案簡介。
簡介裡有營業計畫和一支影片。
接著，創業家在社群媒體上讓大家知道。
人們投資是因為相信這個理念，或是想要禮物、新產品這類回饋。
很多人各出一點點錢，所以沒有人需要出很多。
如果活動沒有達到目標，就沒有人需要付錢。
一間叫 Pebble 的公司用群眾募資開發智慧手錶。
它不到一天就募到超過 100 萬美元，最後募到超過 1,000 萬美元。
兩兄弟想募 3,000 美元做看起來像熊的外套，結果募到 30,000 美元！
全世界的人在 2013 年捐了 60 億美元，2014 年是 160 億美元。
有了群眾募資，任何人都能把大膽或瘋狂的點子帶到世界上。

steps.q: How did entrepreneurs get money in the past?
opts: From relatives, banks, or rich investors
ozh: 跟親戚、銀行或有錢的投資人
steps.hint: 找 In the past，後面列了三個地方。
steps.why: In the past, they borrowed money from relatives, took loans from banks, or asked rich investors. 群眾募資是「現在」才有的方法。

steps.q: What is the first step of crowdfunding?
opts: Start a project profile on a website
ozh: 在網站上建立專案簡介
steps.hint: 找 First。
steps.why: First, the entrepreneur starts a project profile on a crowdfunding website. First 就是第一步的路標。

steps.q: Why do people invest in a crowdfunding campaign?
opts: They believe in the cause or want rewards.
ozh: 他們相信這個理念，或想要回饋。
steps.hint: 找 because，後面有兩個原因（中間用 or 連起來）。
steps.why: People invest because they believe in the cause, or because they want rewards. 兩個原因：理念、回饋。

steps.q: What happens if the campaign doesn't reach its goal?
steps.hint: 找 If the campaign doesn't reach its goal…，後面用了本單元的不定代名詞。
steps.why: If the campaign doesn't reach its goal, no one pays anything. no one＝沒有人、anything＝任何東西：沒有人要付任何錢。

steps.q: How long did Pebble take to raise over $1 million?
steps.hint: 數字偵探：找 $1 million，看後面的 in…
steps.why: It raised over $1 million in less than a day. $10 million 是「最後」募到的總數。

steps.q: The brothers hoped to get $3,000. What happened?
ozh: 他們募到 30,000 美元，多了十倍。
他們募到 3,000 美元，剛好一樣。
steps.hint: 兩個數字差了一個 0。
steps.why: Two brothers wanted $3,000 … but they got $30,000! 3,000 × 10 = 30,000。but 表示結果跟想的不一樣。

sum: 在募資網站放營業計畫和影片
相信理念或想要回饋；沒達標就不收錢
Pebble 一天募到 100 萬美元；熊外套 3,000 → 30,000

practice.title: Lily's Hot Lunchbox
sents: Lily is an entrepreneur, and she is only sixteen.
She wants to make a lunchbox that keeps food hot for ten hours.
First, she made a project profile with a short video.
Then she shared it on social media with her friends and relatives.
Her goal was $5,000.
In the first week, nobody donated, and Lily felt blue.
Then a famous cook shared her video, and everyone started talking about it.
After one month, the campaign raised $50,000!
Each person who gave $30 will get a lunchbox as a reward.
zh: Lily 是一位創業家，她才十六歲。
她想做一個可以讓食物保溫十小時的便當盒。
首先，她做了一個附短片的專案簡介。
接著，她在社群媒體上分享給朋友和親戚。
她的目標是 5,000 美元。
第一週都沒有人捐錢，Lily 很沮喪。
後來一位有名的廚師分享了她的影片，大家都開始討論。
一個月後，募資活動募到了 50,000 美元！
每個出 30 美元的人都會收到一個便當盒當回饋。

tasks.q: 把 Lily 的募資過程照順序排好
items: She made a project profile with a video.
她做了附影片的專案簡介。
She shared it on social media.
她在社群媒體上分享。
A famous cook shared her video, and money came in.
有名的廚師分享影片，錢開始進來。
tasks.hint: 找 First、Then、Then：一個一個往下排。
tasks.why: First 做簡介 → Then 分享到社群媒體 → Then 廚師分享、大家開始討論，最後募到錢。

tasks.q: 🔢 數字偵探：Lily wanted $5,000 and got $50,000. How much more is that?
tasks.hint: 5,000 後面多一個 0 是多少倍？
tasks.why: 5,000 × 10 = 50,000，跟課文的熊外套一樣多了十倍。

tasks.q: 🔍 哪一句用了本單元的不定代名詞，告訴你「一開始沒有人捐錢」？點出那一句。
tasks.why: In the first week, nobody donated, and Lily felt blue. nobody＝沒有人；felt blue＝心情很低落。

strategy.name: Fact or Legend?
strategy.intro: 歷史文章裡有「確定的事」，也有「大家說的」。分清楚，才不會把傳說當成事實。

parts.q: 有證據、確定發生過的是什麼？
哪些只是「大家說」？（It is said、It is believed）
以前和現在有什麼不一樣？

strategy.tip: 看到 It is said that、It is believed that、It's likely that，就是「不確定」的路標——這就是本單元的句型！

teach.title: Kung Fu, Wushu, and the World
paras: In action movies, actors often kick and punch instead of using guns.
Fights with hands and feet are closer and more exciting.
In movies, this kind of fighting is called kung fu.
But kung fu is just one style of Chinese martial arts, called wushu.
Nobody knows for sure how wushu began.
It is said that Emperor Huangdi developed wushu 4,000 years ago.
It is also said that poor farmers made it because they had no weapons.
The earliest real evidence is from 2,500 years ago, when a Chinese book explained hand-to-hand fighting for soldiers.
Philosophers wrote about wushu, and Buddhist Shaolin monks made it into a tradition.
Wushu spread to other nations, and each nation changed it.
In the 20th century, movies with Bruce Lee, Jackie Chan, and Jet Li made it famous in the West.
Some styles focus on physical skills, and some focus on the mind and qi.
Today wushu is a competitive sport, but it is not an Olympic sport yet.
zh: 在動作片裡，演員常常用踢和出拳，而不是用槍。
用手腳打鬥距離比較近，也比較刺激。
在電影裡，這種打鬥叫做功夫。
但功夫只是中國武術（wushu）的其中一種派別。
沒有人確定武術是怎麼開始的。
據說黃帝在 4,000 年前發展出武術。
也有人說是貧窮的農夫因為沒有武器才發明的。
最早真正的證據是 2,500 年前，一本中國古書說明了給士兵用的徒手格鬥。
哲學家寫過武術，佛教的少林僧人把它整理成一個傳統。
武術傳到其他國家，每個國家都改變了它。
二十世紀，李小龍、成龍和李連杰的電影讓武術在西方出名。
有些派別專注在身體技巧，有些專注在心靈和氣。
現在武術是一項競賽運動，但還不是奧運項目。

steps.q: What is kung fu?
opts: One style of Chinese martial arts
ozh: 中國武術的其中一種派別
steps.hint: 找 But kung fu is just…
steps.why: kung fu is just one style of Chinese martial arts. just one＝只是其中一種；所有中國武術合起來叫 wushu。

steps.q: "Emperor Huangdi developed wushu." Is this a fact or something people say?
steps.hint: 看句子開頭：It is said that…
steps.why: It is said that＝據說。前一句也說 Nobody knows for sure（沒有人確定），所以這是傳說，不是事實。

steps.q: What is the earliest real evidence of wushu?
opts: A Chinese book from 2,500 years ago
steps.hint: 找 evidence（證據）。4,000 年是「據說」的部分喔。
steps.why: The earliest real evidence is from 2,500 years ago… real evidence＝真正的證據，所以是事實。

steps.q: How did wushu become famous in the West?
steps.hint: 找 the West 和 20th century。
steps.why: In the 20th century, movies with Bruce Lee, Jackie Chan, and Jet Li made it famous in the West.

steps.q: What is wushu today?
opts: A competitive sport, but not an Olympic sport yet
ozh: 一項競賽運動，但還不是奧運項目
steps.hint: 找 Today，注意 but 後面的 not … yet。
steps.why: Today wushu is a competitive sport, but it is not an Olympic sport yet. not … yet＝還沒有。

sum: 黃帝 4,000 年前發明；貧窮農夫沒有武器自己練
2,500 年前的古書寫到徒手格鬥；少林僧人整理成傳統
電影讓西方認識；競賽運動，還不是奧運項目

practice.title: The Story of Tai Chi
sents: Tai chi is a slow and gentle style of wushu.
It is said that a monk made tai chi after he watched a bird fight a snake.
Nobody knows if this story is true.
We do know that tai chi became popular in China about 300 years ago.
In the past, people practiced tai chi as a martial art for battle.
Today, most people practice it to stay healthy.
In many parks in Taiwan, you can see grandparents doing tai chi early in the morning.
It is believed that tai chi helps people focus and sleep better.
zh: 太極是一種緩慢、溫和的武術派別。
據說有一位僧人看了一隻鳥和一條蛇打架之後，創造了太極。
沒有人知道這個故事是不是真的。
我們確定的是，太極大約在 300 年前在中國流行起來。
以前，人們把太極當成戰鬥用的武術來練。
現在，大部分的人練太極是為了保持健康。
在台灣很多公園裡，一大早就可以看到爺爺奶奶在打太極。
一般相信太極能幫助人專心、睡得更好。

tasks.q: 每張卡片是「大家說的（不確定）」還是「確定的事」？（5 張都要分對）
items: A monk made tai chi after watching a bird and a snake.
一位僧人看了鳥和蛇打架才創造太極。
Tai chi helps people focus and sleep better.
太極幫助人專心、睡得更好。
Tai chi became popular about 300 years ago.
太極大約 300 年前開始流行。
Most people practice it to stay healthy today.
現在大部分的人為了健康練太極。
Grandparents do tai chi in parks in Taiwan.
台灣的爺爺奶奶在公園打太極。
tasks.hint: 回去看每一件事的句子開頭：有 It is said／It is believed 的就是「大家說的」。
tasks.why: 鳥和蛇的故事是 It is said；幫助專心睡覺是 It is believed——都是「大家說」。300 年前流行前面有 We do know（我們確定），另外兩件是現在看得到的事。

tasks.q: 🔄 How is tai chi different today?
opts: People practice it for health, not for battle.
People use it more in battles.
ozh: 人們為了健康練，不是為了打仗。
tasks.hint: 找 In the past 和 Today 兩句，比一比。
tasks.why: In the past … for battle；Today … to stay healthy。以前為了打仗，現在為了健康。

tasks.q: 🔍 哪一句告訴你「沒有人確定那個故事是真的」？點出那一句。
tasks.why: Nobody knows if this story is true. 所以前一句的鳥和蛇只是傳說。

strategy.name: Cause and Effect
strategy.intro: 每件事都有「為什麼」和「後來怎樣」。把原因和結果連起來，長文章就變成一條一條的線。

parts.q: 發生了什麼事？後來怎麼了？

strategy.tip: because、so、As a result、By … 都是原因和結果之間的路標。

teach.title: Saving Old Places
paras: In 1959, Egypt was building a new dam to control flooding on the Nile River.
But the water from the dam was going to cover many ancient sites.
Egypt didn't like either option, so the leaders asked the United Nations for help.
Important objects were moved to other places.
As a result, the UN started a group to protect important places, now called World Heritage Sites.
People have always looked back to the past for inspiration.
About 500 years ago, people in Europe studied the ancient Greeks and Romans.
By studying old writers, they developed the scientific method.
Because of the scientific method, we are learning at a faster and faster pace today.
One of the earliest cities, Catal Huyuk, was in Turkey near a river.
Animals came to the river to drink, so the people there didn't have to travel to hunt.
It may not have been the first city, but it was one of the largest.
Sadly, some groups destroy old sites on purpose, like the huge Buddha statues in Afghanistan.
We should all work harder to protect our heritage.
zh: 1959 年，埃及正在蓋一座新水壩，用來控制尼羅河的水災。
但是水壩的水會淹掉很多古蹟。
埃及兩個選擇都不喜歡，所以領導人請聯合國幫忙。
重要的古物被搬到其他地方。
結果，聯合國成立了一個組織來保護重要的地方，現在叫做世界遺產。
人們一直都從過去尋找靈感。
大約 500 年前，歐洲人研究古希臘人和古羅馬人。
他們藉由研究古代作家，發展出科學方法。
因為科學方法，我們現在學習的速度越來越快。
最早的城市之一——加泰土丘，在土耳其的一條河邊。
動物會來河邊喝水，所以那裡的人不用到處遷移去打獵。
它可能不是第一座城市，但它是最大的城市之一。
很可惜，有些團體故意破壞古蹟，像阿富汗巨大的佛像。
我們都應該更努力保護我們的文化遺產。

steps.q: Why did Egypt ask the UN for help?
opts: The new dam was going to cover ancient sites with water.
Egypt needed money for the dam.
The UN wanted to build a new city.
ozh: 新水壩的水會淹掉古蹟。
聯合國想蓋一座新城市。
steps.hint: 找 so：so 前面是原因。再往前一句看是什麼問題。
steps.why: the water from the dam was going to cover many ancient sites → 兩個選擇都不好 → so 請聯合國幫忙。

steps.q: What happened as a result?
opts: The UN started a group to protect important places.
All the old sites were destroyed.
ozh: 聯合國成立了保護重要地方的組織。
steps.hint: 找 As a result（結果）。
steps.why: As a result, the UN started a group to protect important places. 這就是「世界遺產」的由來。文章沒說埃及不蓋水壩。

steps.q: What did people in Europe develop by studying old writers?
steps.hint: 找 By studying…（藉由研究……）。
steps.why: By studying old writers, they developed the scientific method. 研究古人（原因）→ 科學方法（結果）。

steps.q: Why didn't the people in Catal Huyuk need to travel to hunt?
opts: Animals came to the river to drink.
steps.hint: 找 so，so 前面就是原因。
steps.why: Animals came to the river to drink, so the people there didn't have to travel. 動物自己來了，就不用出去找。

steps.q: What does "It may not have been the first city" mean?
opts: Maybe it was not the first city; we are not sure.
It was surely the first city.
ozh: 它可能不是第一座城市，我們不確定。
steps.hint: may not have been＝本單元句型，用來「猜」過去的事。
steps.why: may not have been＝可能不是（不確定）。後面 but it was one of the largest 才是確定的事。

sum: 古蹟會被淹 → 請聯合國 → 世界遺產
科學方法 → 學得越來越快
不用遷移 → 早期的大城市

practice.title: The Green Stairs
sents: High in the mountains of the Philippines, there are rice terraces that look like giant green stairs.
People carved them into the mountains about 2,000 years ago.
They may have built them because flat land was hard to find.
Water from the forest flows down from one step to the next, so the rice always gets enough water.
However, many young people moved to the cities to find jobs.
As a result, nobody took care of some terraces, and they started to fall apart.
In 1995, the terraces became a World Heritage Site.
Now people are working together to save them.
zh: 在菲律賓的高山上，有看起來像巨大綠色樓梯的梯田。
人們大約在 2,000 年前把它們開鑿在山上。
他們可能是因為很難找到平地，才蓋了梯田。
森林的水從一層流到下一層，所以稻子總是有足夠的水。
可是，很多年輕人搬到城市找工作。
結果，有些梯田沒人照顧，開始崩壞。
1995 年，梯田成為世界遺產。
現在人們一起努力拯救它們。

tasks.q: 每張卡片是「原因」還是「結果」？（4 張都要分對）
items: Water flows down from one step to the next.
水從一層流到下一層。
The rice always gets enough water.
稻子總是有足夠的水。
Young people moved to the cities.
年輕人搬到城市。
Some terraces started to fall apart.
有些梯田開始崩壞。
tasks.hint: 找 so 和 As a result：它們前面是原因，後面是結果。
tasks.why: 水往下流（原因）→ so 稻子有水（結果）；年輕人離開（原因）→ As a result 梯田崩壞（結果）。

tasks.q: Why did some terraces start to fall apart?
opts: Young people moved away, so nobody took care of them.
They became a World Heritage Site.
ozh: 年輕人搬走了，所以沒有人照顧。
tasks.hint: 往前找兩句：However… 和 As a result…
tasks.why: 很多年輕人搬到城市 → 沒人照顧 → 梯田崩壞。變成世界遺產是之後為了救它們。

tasks.q: 🔍 哪一句用了本單元句型（may／might／could have ＋ p.p.）來「猜」原因？點出那一句。
tasks.why: They may have built them because flat land was hard to find. may have built＝可能蓋了（猜的，不確定）。

strategy.name: How It Works + Who Says?
strategy.intro: 介紹機器的文章：先弄懂它怎麼運作，再分清楚「誰說它有用、誰說沒用」。

parts.q: 機器量什麼？步驟是什麼？
這是誰的看法？大家都同意嗎？

strategy.tip: Many investigators say…、Scientists say…、Some people say… Others say… 表示不同的人有不同的看法，要看清楚是誰說的。

teach.title: Can a Machine Catch a Liar?
paras: A lie detector test, or polygraph, is used to check if someone is lying.
Sensors are put on the person's hands and chest.
They measure vital signs, like breathing, pulse, blood pressure, and perspiration.
When people lie, these signs may change.
First, the interviewer asks easy questions, like "Is your name Bob?"
Then she asks control questions, like "Have you ever lied to get out of trouble?"
Almost everyone has done this, but most people say "no."
By comparing the vital signs, the interviewer tries to tell if the person is lying about the crime.
Many investigators say polygraphs are right about 90% of the time.
But scientists say they are only a little better than guessing.
That is why they can't be used in court in most countries.
Some people trick them by staying calm or by thinking of something stressful.
Scientists are now testing fMRI, which shows which parts of the brain a person is using, but it is not good enough yet.
zh: 測謊，也叫做多項生理記錄儀，是用來檢查一個人有沒有說謊。
感應器放在這個人的手和胸口上。
它們測量生命徵象，像是呼吸、脈搏、血壓和流汗。
人說謊的時候，這些徵象可能會改變。
首先，問話的人會問簡單的問題，像是「你的名字是 Bob 嗎？」
接著她問控制問題，像是「你曾經為了逃避麻煩說過謊嗎？」
幾乎每個人都做過，但大部分的人會說「沒有」。
藉由比較生命徵象，問話的人試著判斷這個人在犯罪的事情上有沒有說謊。
很多調查人員說測謊大約有 90% 的時候是準的。
但是科學家說它只比用猜的好一點點。
這就是為什麼在大部分國家，它不能在法庭上使用。
有些人藉由保持冷靜，或想一件很有壓力的事來騙過測謊。
科學家現在在測試 fMRI，它可以看出一個人正在用大腦的哪些部位，但還不夠好。

steps.q: What does a polygraph measure?
opts: Breathing, pulse, blood pressure, and perspiration
Which parts of the brain you use
steps.hint: 找 measure（測量）。大腦是 fMRI 量的喔。
steps.why: They measure vital signs, like breathing, pulse, blood pressure, and perspiration. They＝前一句的 Sensors。

steps.q: Which is a control question?
opts: Have you ever lied to get out of trouble?
ozh: 你曾經為了逃避麻煩說過謊嗎？
你的名字是 Bob 嗎？
steps.hint: First 問簡單題，Then 才問 control questions。
steps.why: Then she asks control questions, like "Have you ever lied to get out of trouble?" 名字是 First 的簡單題。

steps.q: Why do control questions work?
opts: Almost everyone has done it, but most people say "no."
ozh: 幾乎每個人都做過，但大部分人會說「沒有」。
steps.hint: 看控制題後面那一句：大家「做過」，但「說」什麼？
steps.why: Almost everyone has done this, but most people say "no." 大家都會在這題說謊，問話的人就能拿來比較。

steps.q: Who says polygraphs are right about 90% of the time?
steps.hint: 誰說的？找 90% 前面的人。
steps.why: Many investigators say polygraphs are right about 90% of the time. 科學家的看法剛好相反（But scientists say…）。

steps.q: Why can't polygraphs be used in court?
opts: Scientists say they are only a little better than guessing.
ozh: 科學家說它只比猜的好一點。
steps.hint: That is why…＝這就是為什麼。往前一句找原因。
steps.why: scientists say they are only a little better than guessing → That is why they can't be used in court.

steps.q: How can a person trick a polygraph?
opts: By staying calm or thinking of something stressful
ozh: 保持冷靜，或想一件有壓力的事
steps.hint: 找 by ＋ V-ing——本單元的句型！
steps.why: Some people trick them by staying calm or by thinking of something stressful. by ＋ V-ing＝用什麼方法。

sum: 感應器放在手和胸口，量呼吸、脈搏、血壓、流汗
先問簡單題，再問控制題，比較生命徵象
只比猜的好一點 → 不能在法庭用

practice.title: Lies in Your Eyes?
sents: Some people believe you can catch a liar by watching his or her eyes.
They say liars look away or move their eyes back and forth.
Other people say liars stare at you to seem honest.
Scientists tested this idea with videos of people telling lies and telling the truth.
First, they recorded each person's eyes with a camera.
Then they compared the liars and the honest people.
They found that their eyes moved in almost the same way.
So, watching someone's eyes is not an accurate way to catch a liar.
zh: 有些人相信看一個人的眼睛就能抓到說謊的人。
他們說說謊的人會把視線移開，或眼睛轉來轉去。
也有人說說謊的人會盯著你看，讓自己看起來很誠實。
科學家用人們說謊和說實話的影片來測試這個想法。
首先，他們用攝影機錄下每個人的眼睛。
接著，他們比較說謊的人和誠實的人。
他們發現這些人的眼睛動的方式幾乎一樣。
所以，看一個人的眼睛不是準確抓到說謊者的方法。

tasks.q: 每張卡片是「有些人這樣說」還是「科學家發現的」？（4 張都要分對）
items: Liars look away or move their eyes back and forth.
說謊的人會移開視線或眼睛轉來轉去。
Liars stare at you to seem honest.
說謊的人會盯著你看。
Liars and honest people move their eyes in almost the same way.
說謊和誠實的人眼睛動的方式幾乎一樣。
Watching eyes is not an accurate way to catch a liar.
看眼睛不是準確的方法。
tasks.hint: 看每句前面是 They say／Other people say，還是 Scientists… They found…
tasks.why: 前兩張是 They say、Other people say（有些人說）；後兩張是科學家測試之後 They found 的結果。

tasks.q: 把科學家的實驗照順序排好
items: They recorded each person's eyes.
錄下每個人的眼睛。
They compared the liars and the honest people.
比較說謊和誠實的人。
They found the eyes moved in almost the same way.
發現眼睛動的方式幾乎一樣。
tasks.why: First 錄影 → Then 比較 → They found 得到結果。

tasks.q: 🔍 句型尋寶：哪一句用了 with ＋ (n.) 說科學家「用什麼東西」錄影？點出那一句。
tasks.why: First, they recorded each person's eyes with a camera. with a camera＝用攝影機。
